PHONICS & BEGINNING SOUNDS WORKSHEETS

Phonics & Beginning Sounds worksheets — free printables for age 4.

Beginning sounds, rhymes, blending and word building — every sheet works on paper with a parent sound script. Every sheet twins with a real game in Phonics & Beginning Sounds (Class 28) — download the PDF, print from the page, or play online.

Sound Detective Age 4Class 28Phonics Detective ear training on paper: a target sound, three pictures — circle every one that starts with it. View Worksheet → Treasure Chest Sounds Age 4Class 28Phonics Six picture cards, two treasure chests: cut them out and sort by beginning sound. View Worksheet → Rhyming Frog Hop Age 4Class 28Phonics Words that rhyme share their ending — hop each frog word to its rhyming partner with a drawn line. View Worksheet → Robot Sound Blender Age 4Class 28Phonics c…a…t — say the robot sounds slowly, write each letter, and read the whole word back. View Worksheet → Birdsong Sound Match Age 4Class 28Phonics Two birds of a feather: connect the pictures that share their beginning sound. View Worksheet → Elephant’s Sound Bubbles Age 4Class 28Phonics A letter in the bubble, three pictures below — circle every picture whose word starts with that sound. View Worksheet → Pirate’s Missing Sound Age 4Class 28Phonics The pirate stole the first letter of every word! Write it back: _at, _un, _og. View Worksheet → Ice Cream Rhyme Shop Age 4Class 28Phonics Rhyme orders at the ice cream shop: match the pictures whose words share their ending. View Worksheet → Crocodile Sound Chomper Age 4Class 28Phonics The crocodile chomps ENDINGS: say each word and circle the letter it ends with. View Worksheet → Kangaroo Sound Jumps Age 4Class 28Phonics How many sounds live in a word? Tap-jump a circle for every sound you hear. View Worksheet → Muffin Middle Sounds Age 4Class 28Phonics The middle vowel ran away from every muffin word! Circle the vowel that fits: c_t, h_n, d_g, s_n. View Worksheet → Owl’s Sound Sorting Library Age 4Class 28Phonics The owl’s library needs sorting: every picture card goes to the shelf of its first sound. View Worksheet → Penguin Syllable Drums Age 4Class 28Phonics Drum the syllables: say each word, color a drum for every beat you hear. View Worksheet → Raccoon’s Odd Sound Hunt Age 4Class 28Phonics Three words start the same, one is the odd raccoon — circle the impostor. View Worksheet → Submarine Sound Scanner Age 4Class 28Phonics Scan the word front to back: do you hear the sound at the START or at the END? Circle that box. View Worksheet → Bunny Word Family Village Age 4Class 28Phonics Two word-family houses on Bunny’s street: -at and -an. Cut the word cards, read them, glue them home. View Worksheet → Sloth’s Blending Slide Age 4Class 28Phonics Slide down the blending slide: the first letter is given, sound out the rest, finish the word. View Worksheet → Unicorn Sound Swap Age 4Class 28Phonics Magic swap: change ONE sound and the word turns into another word. cat becomes hat! View Worksheet → Dinosaur Sound Train Age 4Class 28Phonics Three train cars per word: say the sounds, write the letters, read the word — chugga chugga! View Worksheet → Monkey’s Missing Middle Age 4Class 28Phonics The monkey dropped the middle of every word! b_d, p_g, c_p — feed the monkey the vowels. View Worksheet → Firefly Sound Counting Age 4Class 28Phonics Fireflies flash once per sound: count the flashes — sounds, not letters! View Worksheet → Polar Bear Word Builder Age 4Class 28Phonics The polar bear’s words are frozen! Unfreeze them: say the sounds and write each letter. View Worksheet → Mermaid’s Sound Switch Age 4Class 28Phonics The mermaid switches the LAST sound: cat becomes can, cup becomes cub. Make the swap, write the new word. View Worksheet → Dragon’s Secret Sound Paths Age 4Class 28Phonics A winding path to the dragon’s cave: circle every /s/ picture you pass on the way. View Worksheet →
